title: StatementDraftContribution
description: Value of a Contribution posted onto the Statement panel with slot = Draft. Carries a populated GSM statement payload conforming to the resolved archetype JSON Schema. Default ContributionResolver = `compose`: per-key merge of the inner `statement` object across competing Draft contributions, so multiple StatementShapingKSs can populate disjoint archetype fields cooperatively (each KS posts a partial statement; engine assembles the union).

shapingMethod.description: Identifier of the shaping method (e.g. structural-extraction, llm-behavioral-lift).
